rules.trigger_condition: Feedstock average moisture > 30% over last 30 days
rules.recommended_action: Notify feedstock manager; review drying system performance; consider feedstock blend adjustment

rules.trigger_condition: Feedstock supply contracts signed for < 70% of annual requirement
rules.recommended_action: Prioritise remaining feedstock contract negotiation; identify additional suppliers; engage procurement team

rules.trigger_condition: Gasifier vendor delivery > 30 days past contractual milestone
rules.recommended_action: Expedite vendor with formal notice; escalate to project director; evaluate liquidated damages application

rules.trigger_condition: HAZOP study not completed within 3 months of FEED completion
rules.recommended_action: Mobilise HAZOP team immediately; prioritise HAZOP nodes; extend FEED schedule if needed

rules.trigger_condition: HAZOP recommendations close-out < 80% 3 months before planned start-up
rules.recommended_action: Hold weekly HAZOP closure meetings; assign owners to all open recommendations; escalate unresolved items

rules.trigger_condition: Syngas cleanup package procurement not ordered within 4 months of EPC award
rules.recommended_action: Expedite purchase order; evaluate standardisation to reduce engineering time; mobilise procurement team

rules.trigger_condition: Methanol synthesis catalyst order not placed >12 months before planned loading date
rules.recommended_action: Place catalyst order urgently; negotiate lead time with supplier; evaluate alternative catalyst sources

rules.trigger_condition: H2/CO ratio target (stoichiometric number) not defined or achievable by FEED gate
rules.recommended_action: Require process design team to resolve ratio target; evaluate WGS sizing; consider H2 make-up option

rules.trigger_condition: Methanol synthesis loop design not started by Phase 3 gate
rules.recommended_action: Start methanol loop design immediately; mobilise licensor design support; review critical path impact

rules.trigger_condition: EIA not submitted for regulatory review by Phase 2 gate
rules.recommended_action: Accelerate EIA completion; engage regulatory consultant; review submission checklist

rules.trigger_condition: Environmental clearance not received by Phase 3/FID gate
rules.recommended_action: Engage senior regulatory liaison; prepare supplemental submissions; evaluate concurrent permit applications

rules.trigger_condition: Commissioning readiness assessment not scheduled at 6 months before target start-up
rules.recommended_action: Schedule commissioning readiness workshop; review commissioning team staffing; identify procedure gaps

rules.trigger_condition: Commissioning punch list > 10% open at scheduled start date
rules.recommended_action: Hold daily punch list resolution meeting; allocate additional construction workforce; prioritise safety-critical items

rules.trigger_condition: First methanol product quality fails IMPCA spec
rules.recommended_action: Isolate product to slop tank; adjust distillation parameters; involve licensor support; evaluate catalyst issues

rules.trigger_condition: Performance guarantee test not passed within 6 weeks of first methanol production
rules.recommended_action: Commission root cause analysis; engage licensor for optimisation; negotiate with EPC contractor

rules.trigger_condition: Syngas tar content after cleanup exceeds 50 mg/Nm³ during commissioning
rules.recommended_action: Review tar reformer/cracker performance; check catalyst condition; evaluate tar sampling method

rules.trigger_condition: Biomass storage capacity < 14 days at nameplate consumption
rules.recommended_action: Review storage sizing; evaluate covered storage expansion; maintain minimum stockpile level of 30 days during monsoon

rules.trigger_condition: Feedstock logistics transport disruption > 7 days
rules.recommended_action: Activate alternative transport route; draw from strategic stockpile; contact backup suppliers

rules.trigger_condition: Methanol storage tank permit not applied for by Phase 3 completion
rules.recommended_action: Submit storage tank permit application immediately; engage PESO/explosives expert; expedite fire NOC

rules.trigger_condition: Oxygen supply (from ASU or third-party) delivery delayed > 30 days
rules.recommended_action: Expedite ASU delivery; evaluate liquid oxygen backup; consider emergency third-party oxygen supply

rules.trigger_condition: Water abstraction or groundwater clearance not obtained before Phase 4 start
rules.recommended_action: Expedite water permits; engage consultant for additional studies; evaluate temporary water supply arrangement

rules.trigger_condition: Capital cost > 110% of approved budget at any gate (excluding approved contingency)
rules.recommended_action: Initiate cost control review; freeze new change orders; report to project board; evaluate contingency draw-down

rules.trigger_condition: Schedule delay > 3 months from latest approved baseline
rules.recommended_action: Commission schedule recovery plan; identify critical path recovery; evaluate acceleration options (overtime, parallel work, additional shifts)

rules.trigger_condition: EPC contractor monthly progress < 90% of plan for 3 consecutive months
rules.recommended_action: Hold contractor performance review; mobilise additional contractor resources; escalate to contractor senior management

rules.trigger_condition: Project financing not closed by original FID date
rules.recommended_action: Lender engagement meeting; address due diligence gaps; consider bridge financing or equity injection

rules.trigger_condition: Gasifier availability < 90% during first 6 months of operations
rules.recommended_action: Root cause analysis of unplanned shutdowns; review maintenance strategy; warranty claim evaluation

rules.trigger_condition: Health index of project on-track items < 50% (more red items than green)
rules.recommended_action: Risk review workshop; establish recovery plans for red items; realign resources

rules.trigger_condition: ISCC/RSB certification pre-audit not scheduled within 3 months of first production date
rules.recommended_action: Accelerate certification evidence package completion; engage certification consultant; escalate to project sponsor

rules.trigger_condition: Chain-of-custody documentation gaps identified in sustainability audit
rules.recommended_action: Identify gaps in feedstock mass balance or GHG calculation records; remediate documentation before formal certification audit

rules.trigger_condition: Wastewater discharge quality exceeds 80% of consent limit for any parameter
rules.recommended_action: Investigate wastewater treatment plant performance; check for process upset or nutrient dosing issues; engage water treatment specialist

rules.trigger_condition: Methanol synthesis catalyst PO not placed at least 10 months before scheduled commissioning
rules.recommended_action: Expedite catalyst procurement; engage alternative suppliers; assess impact on commissioning sequence

rules.trigger_condition: Feedstock average moisture exceeds 28% over a 14-day rolling window
rules.recommended_action: Notify feedstock manager; increase covered storage utilisation; blend with drier feedstock sources; check drying system performance
